The '''Wideview Binocular Dome Head''' was a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] head manufactured by [[AccuTronics/Legends|AccuTronics]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="DW" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Wideview Binocular Dome Head was one of the basic droid parts that appeared in the [[1998]] video game ''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''.<ref name="DW" /> Although the name of the company is spelled "AccuTronics," with a capital T,<ref name="EGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> the game used the spelling "Accutronics."<ref name="DW" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''
